title: Decision nav (4)
description: Design-doc / RFC overview: Overview → Problem → Design → Landing. No Day-1 command tab.
antiPatterns: a Day-1 tab without a copyable recipe
competitors or full task DAG on overview by default
Play/Step/demo chrome without per-frame insight and structural change
acceptance matrix or L0–Ln backlog on the primary view
agentPrompt: Build a composition Canvas with exactly 4 ordered Tabs (ids: overview primary, problem, design, landing). Resolve visible labels from i18n/nav.json using locale= (labels[id][locale] ?? labels[id].en ?? view.label). This pack is the default for content=design-doc. Do NOT add a Day-1 / path tab. Put migration phases and acceptance on landing only. Start from templates/decision.canvas.tsx and rewrite all user-visible copy into the user's language.
